summary_en: This Phase III study compares stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) at higher doses and different schedules with standard palliative radiation therapy for painful bone metastases. Participants are randomized to radiation given as one treatment, or as 3 or 5 daily treatments, with the record listing 8 Gy in one treatment or 20 Gy in 5 treatments as the standard arm and 16 Gy in one treatment or 27 Gy in 3 treatments in the other arm. The record does not state the main outcome measured; the study is listed as Phase III.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase III compara la radioterapia corporal estereotáctica (SBRT) con dosis más altas y diferentes esquemas frente a la radioterapia paliativa estándar para metástasis óseas dolorosas. Los participantes son asignados al azar a radiación en una sola sesión, o en 3 o 5 sesiones diarias, y el registro indica 8 Gy en una sesión o 20 Gy en 5 sesiones como brazo estándar, y 16 Gy en una sesión o 27 Gy en 3 sesiones en el otro brazo. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; el estudio aparece registrado como Fase III.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a solid tumor and bone metastases on imaging (multiple myeloma is also eligible).
Pain or discomfort at the proposed treatment site.
Life expectancy of 3 months or more.
Able to complete pain assessment and quality of life surveys.
Able to understand and sign a written informed consent document.
not_for: Prior radiation therapy to the proposed treatment site.
Untreated spinal cord compression at the treatment site.
Unstable radiographic or pathologic fracture at the treatment site that is not mechanically stabilized.
Metastases along the cervical, thoracic, or lumbar spine (unless the primary site invades the paraspinal or spine region).
